objectives.note: Farmer Li's cabbages are being nibbled (existing event m_farm.2).
Any fight in realm 1 counts.
Return to Farmer Li.

quests.summary: Chase 8 horned rabbits away from Farmer Li's cabbage field, then tell him they're gone.

objectives.note: Li: 'My hoe! Where did it go?' (existing event m_farm.1)
Existing story event well_hint (m_well.3).
Existing event m_well.1 (cond questActive q1_hoe).
Existing story farmer_thanks (m_farm.3).

quests.summary: Farmer Li dropped his hoe somewhere; spot the glint in the old well and bring it back.

objectives.note: Xiaoming: '救命! A rabbit took my golden carrot!' (existing event w_path.1)
Existing event w_nest.1 (thief mini-boss).
The thief hid it by Clover Lake: existing event w_lake.1.
Xiaoming waits at home in Little Hill Village (hook turnIn).

quests.summary: Beat the speedy thief rabbit in its nest, find the golden carrot by Clover Lake and take it home to Xiaoming.

objectives.note: Duoduo (6) lost her toy panda picking flowers in the woods (Jack's 'lost item in the woods').
Xiaolong spots a trail of paw-print stickers.
Up a hollow tree at a dead end (quest item fires before the chest).
Duoduo hugs it: 谢谢!

quests.summary: Follow the sticker trail through the Flower Glade to find Duoduo's toy panda and bring it home.

objectives.note: The beekeeper's veils are torn; the bees are cranky.
Drops from Forest Spiders.
Granny Mi sews new veils.

quests.summary: Collect 5 strands of spider silk so Granny Mi can mend her bee veils.

objectives.note: Granny Bai 'happens to be in town' and offers a first spell lesson.
3 soap-flowers on side branches (quest items).
Get 8 Flower Glade words Ready (battle or practice).
She teaches 泡泡术; Honey Town's shelf shows 'Granny Bai's lesson' instead of a price.

rewards.spellRule: The spell replaces buying it: its magic-shop shelf shows this quest instead of a price while the quest is open; if the kid already owns it, the giver pays its shop price in gold instead.

quests.summary: Gather 3 soap-flowers and learn 8 forest words; Granny Bai teaches you your first spell, Bubble Spell.

objectives.note: Yezi the elf: the bees blame Honey Town for a theft.
Guards around Pipi's stash.
Pipi's stash: the jar and a red feather. First proof it was Pipi.
After the Queen's battle, give the jelly back (clear scene).
Yezi teaches Heal (spec: Honeycomb quest).

quests.summary: Find the royal jelly Pipi stole, return it to the Queen Bee, and Yezi teaches you Heal.

objectives.note: Fei's little sister: bandits took him (Jack's 'rescue a friend from bandits in a cave').
Fei's wooden sword and a ransom note: 一共多少钱?
The Sack Brothers in their cave.
Untie Fei (scene after the clear).
Reunion; Fei grumbles 谢谢.

quests.summary: Follow the ransom note to the bandits' cave, beat the Sack Brothers and bring Fei home to his sister.

objectives.note: The hat seller's stock was stolen by bandits wearing it all at once.

quests.summary: Knock 5 stolen hats off the road bandits' heads and return them to the hat stall.

objectives.note: Boss Qian's toy cart must reach the outpost.
The cart follows; fights on the way as normal.
A cheeky toll-goblin wants money: 太贵了! / 便宜一点儿吧 (choice).
Qian meets you at the outpost.

quests.summary: Walk Boss Qian's toy cart down the highway to the outpost, haggling a cheeky toll-goblin down on the way.

objectives.note: An old lantern seller dropped his wallet down here.
Decoy: a normal chest, but no wallet. 'Not this one!'
A mimic swallowed the wallet.

quests.summary: Track the old lantern seller's red wallet to the mimic that swallowed it, and give it back.

objectives.note: The dye-maker's stall is in Crossroads Market (the night_bazaar overworld has no village; the bazaar itself is the bazaar_cellars dungeon). Offered after the crossroads_highway boss. She needs jelly in four colors.
One of each color (the slime shouts its color).

quests.summary: Defeat a red, a yellow, a blue and a green slime so the dye-maker can paint the market.

objectives.note: He escaped the goblins, but his schoolbag didn't.
Enter Goblin Caves L1.
Under a pile of bat-chewed pencils.

quests.summary: Find Xiaohu's schoolbag in the Cave Mouth and bring it back to the miners' camp.

objectives.note: The dwarf foreman's lamps went out; bats love the dark.
Glow-moss clings to cave bats.

quests.summary: Collect 5 clumps of glow-moss from cave bats so Uncle Shi's dwarves can light the mine again.

title.en: Three Kids in the Crystal Tunnels

objectives.note: A paper-plane note from Teacher Zhang (the offer): three kids are hidden in the tunnels.
Kid 1 locked in a crystal cupboard.
Kid 2 guarded by a brute 'on detention duty'.
Kid 3 behind a door that opens for 请 + 谢谢.
The kids run home; parents cheer.

quests.summary: Use Teacher Zhang's paper-plane note to find three classmates hidden in the Crystal Tunnels and send them home.

objectives.note: After the Headmaster falls, the hall monitors still hoard the class's homework.
They hand pages back when beaten.

quests.summary: Beat 6 goblin hall monitors to win back the class's homework for Teacher Zhang.

title.en: A Bell for a Real School

objectives.note: The dwarves forged a school bell so goblins can have a real school.
Back into the caves (inn warp allowed).
Goblins line up for their first real lesson: 老师好!

quests.summary: Carry the dwarves' new bell down to Teacher Zhang, who is opening a real school for the goblins.

objectives.note: His 1,000th birthday! Three invitations to hand out.
Party scene with cake.

quests.summary: Hand Grandpa Turtle's birthday invitations to three friends around the swamp and come back for cake.

objectives.note: Bog monsters make the village kids 迟到 every morning.

quests.summary: Clear 8 bog monsters off the morning road so the swamp kids stop being late for school.

objectives.note: A girl followed a wisp's light and got lost.
She follows you and hides during fights.
She wants to follow the wisp again: 一会儿 / 现在 (choice).
Grandma rewards you.

quests.summary: Walk little Xiaohe safely through the fog to her grandma's house at the outpost.

objectives.note: Bog lizards stole the town clock's spare watches.

quests.summary: Take back 5 pocket watches from the bog lizards so Grandpa Turtle can fix the town clock.

objectives.note: His two sons went deeper and haven't come back.
Hiding behind roots.
Stuck on an island; Xiaolong makes a reed bridge.
The wisp that lured them.

quests.summary: Find the old fisher's two sons deep in the Hydra's Lair, chase off the wisp that lured them, and report back.

objectives.note: After meeting Madame Mist: 'Her fog comes from a bottle. Break it!'
Guardians of the bottle.
He seals it and gives you his old shell shield.

gear.perk: heroic: first broken block per battle leaks 1 less

quests.summary: Beat the guardians of Madame Mist's fog bottle on the Lair's lower level and bring it to Grandpa Turtle to seal.

objectives.note: Dawn Chapel is out of medicine.
3 herb patches at dead ends (quest item before the chest).
Xiaolong sniffs one and sneezes.

quests.summary: Gather 3 sun-herbs from the foggy village's corners so Dr. An can brew medicine.

objectives.note: Cured villagers are weak; soup helps.
你怎么了? / 我头疼
你没事吧? / 没事

quests.summary: Carry Cook Ma's hot soup to three recovering villagers and ask how they feel.

objectives.note: Old Mine (optional).
Two miners are stuck behind sick, grumpy zombies.
Cured on defeat.
The miners: 我很害怕 → 别怕.

quests.summary: Cure the zombies blocking the Old Mine tunnel and lead two scared miners out.

objectives.note: His dog chased a skeleton's bone boomerang into the crypt.
Empty kennel, only paw prints (a 'nothing' beat that points onward).
Blackie is chewing the boomerang, very proud.

quests.summary: Follow the paw prints into the Moonlit Crypt and bring the gravekeeper's dog Blackie home.

objectives.note: Skeletons keep knocking over the flowers.

quests.summary: Scatter 8 rattle skeletons so the gravekeeper can replant the flowers.

objectives.note: Her dad, the village knight, 'turned into a zombie' guarding the crypt.
General Mo refuses Madame Mist's plan (foreshadow).
Cured at 0 HP.
Dad and daughter hug (he waits at npc_2).

quests.summary: Cure Lingling's dad, the Zombie Knight, in the lower crypt and bring father and daughter back together.

objectives.note: (Jack's example.) Granny Xue's snow-tea needs 3 glacier roses that bloom only in snow.
Rose 1 on a windy ledge.
Cloud Caves (optional).
Rose 2 in an ice grotto.
A golem is sitting on rose 3.
Rose 3.
She teaches 雪球术 (or pays its 1,080-gold shop price if already owned).

rewards.spellRule: The spell replaces buying it: its magic-shop shelf shows this quest instead of a price while the quest is open; if the kid already owns it, the giver pays its shop price in gold instead.

quests.summary: Collect 3 glacier roses from the snowy cliffs and the Cloud Caves; Granny Xue teaches you Snowball Volley.

objectives.note: A map-maker who is, embarrassingly, lost: 我迷路了!
Read the signpost: 往左走 / 往右走 / 一直走 (choice).
He gives you a map with a ? on it (marks the Cloud Caves door).

quests.summary: Guide the lost map-maker back to Cloud Ridge by reading the cliff signposts.

objectives.note: Harpies keep stealing socks off the line.

quests.summary: Shoo away 8 sock-stealing harpies from Cloud Ridge's washing lines.

title.en: The Golem Who Only Walks Straight

objectives.note: A cliff golem walked off with the crossroads signpost.

quests.summary: Stop the golem that keeps walking straight through houses and bring back the crossroads signpost.

objectives.note: Yezi needs shed feathers (never plucked!) for elf arrows.
3 feather nests on the Spire's side branches.

quests.summary: Pick up 3 shed griffin feathers from the Spire's nests for Yezi's elf arrows.

title.en: A Chick Far From the Nest

objectives.note: A fluffy chick blown down by the storm (too young to be bewitched).
Harpies want the chick.
Carry it upstairs.
Its mother: 'Free our king.'

quests.summary: Save a griffin chick from harpies and carry it up the Spire to its mother below the King's roost.

objectives.note: The weather sage's forecasts must reach the outposts before the storm.

quests.summary: Run the weather sage's storm forecast out to both Cloud Ridge outposts.

title.en: The Fire Demon in the Wheat

objectives.note: (Jack's example.) A dancing fire demon is burning the crops.
Smoky (never burning-people) fields; cows hiding behind a barn.
Named variant 'Blaze' (fire_elemental); trolls fan the flames.
A rain dance with the farmers.

quests.summary: Defeat Blaze, the dancing fire demon burning Farmer Wang's crops, and his troll helpers.

objectives.note: A young troll kicked his ball into the Beast Pens.
Beast Pens (optional).
He challenges you to a penalty kick (choice).

quests.summary: Fetch a young troll's soccer ball from the Beast Pens and take his penalty-kick challenge.

objectives.note: The arena coach: 'Beat 8 trolls and you enter the tournament as a seed.'

quests.summary: Win 8 fights against arena trolls to finish Coach Niu's drills.

objectives.note: Gladiators wear stolen museum medals on their bottle-cap belts.

quests.summary: Win back 5 bronze medals from ogre gladiators for the Colosseum's little museum.

objectives.note: The fan club's letters for the champion.
His manager takes them backstage.
真的吗? He read them?!

quests.summary: Deliver the fan club's letters to the Ogre Champion's manager under the Colosseum.

objectives.note: The anthem singer is lost under the stands; the final can't start without her.
Pipi's hired hecklers.
She sings; the crowd cheers 加油! (auto-complete).

quests.summary: Lead the anthem singer through the Undercroft past Pipi's hecklers so the final can begin.

objectives.note: Animals kept for 'monster shows' need freeing. Vet Ji works at Arena Town outpost 2 (realm_8/town_3), right next to the Beast Pens door portal_2.
Beast Pens (optional).
The pen keepers, at the dead end past the inn_1 rest stop (quest-gated fight, cond questActive q8_caged_beasts). v3.9: beast_pens_1/miniboss_1 is a campfire inn, so the fight moved here.
Open 3 cages: an elephant, a tiger and a horse run free.

quests.summary: Beat the pen keepers in the Beast Pens and set an elephant, a tiger and a horse free.

objectives.note: The elves join only if their stolen moonstone comes home. Opinion choices: 我同意 / 我觉得...
Shadow Vault (optional).
The elf banner goes up in camp.

quests.summary: Win back the elves' moonstone from the Shadow Vault so the elves join the alliance.

objectives.note: The dwarves need shadow crystals to rebuild the Harmony Bell's frame.
只要……就…… line.

quests.summary: Collect 5 shadow crystals from imps so Uncle Shi's dwarves can rebuild the Harmony Bell's frame.

objectives.note: The beastfolk champion wants proof you fight for everyone.
Dachui cheers from the sidelines (no combat change).
Dachui: 不但……而且……

quests.summary: Defeat 6 demon knights in the Throne Hall levels to earn the beastfolk's trust.

objectives.note: Uncle Wind: three dragonlings are caged in the castle.
Cage guards.

quests.summary: Free three caged dragonlings in the castle's first levels so the dragons join the alliance.

objectives.note: 'A hero is someone who gets up again.'
Her old badge, lost 50 years ago (quest item before the chest).
Get 12 Gate words Ready.
She teaches 再起 Second Wind (spec: Castle quest).

quests.summary: Recover Granny Bai's old hero badge and learn 12 Gate words; she teaches you Second Wind.

objectives.note: Abandoned after the curse breaks: 我投降!
Feather and inn warp allowed; Pipi jokes along the way.
Pipi trades a secret Throne Hall key for a second chance.

quests.summary: Bring the abandoned imp Pipi safely back to Lantern Light Camp, where he trades a secret key for a second chance.

objectives.note: The camp's lanterns keep the fog out.

quests.summary: Carry lantern oil to Lantern Light Camp's three outposts to keep the Demon King's fog away.

economy.targetCounts: gold only (items, gear, spells are bonus)
